title: The Wright brothers' first flight lasted twelve seconds
hook: Look at the instant the Wright Flyer lifts off.
explanation: That first flight lasted twelve seconds. Orville Wright covered one hundred twenty feet before coming back down.
media_relevance: John T. Daniels photographed the first flight at its moment of liftoff.
shots: Open on the credited first-flight photograph and ease toward the aircraft.
Highlight the flight distance with a simple ruler graphic.
Hold the distance and duration side by side for the payoff.
